# Likuid

> Likuid is an all-in-one financial platform for managing risk, making smarter
> decisions, and getting paid — AI credit decisioning and payments
> infrastructure, unified on one platform.

## Product

- [Platform](https://www.likuid.ai/platform): Originate, Unify, Decide, Pay,
  Act and measure Performance — AI agents native to every module.
- [Developers](https://www.likuid.ai/developers): One API for data,
  decisioning and payments.
- [Book a demo](https://www.likuid.ai/demo): See risk and payments working as
  one, on your use case.

- Contact: hello@likuid.ai
